This page contains a log of the actions that the LFK has formally decided to take through its [[LFK Procedures|standard procedures]].

The contents of this page are copied from the records officially kept in [https://framateam.org/lojban/channels/lfk-logs #LFK-logs channel on Mattermost].

== Launching the Official Lojban Dictionary project ==

Action proposed by [[User:Aris|Aris]] on January 24, 2020:

* I call for consensus to launch [[LFK Dictionary Project|The Official Lojban Dictionary project]] with [[User:Maik|maik]] as coordinator.

This action was declared taken by Maik on February 6, 2020.
